This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
3.

This Writ Petition has been filed by the Petitioner with the following prayer:-
"The Petitioner therefore prays that the Honourable Court be pleased to admit this application and after hearing the petitioner's advocate issue a writ in nature of mandamus or any other suitable writ directing to the Zone Officer-cum-L.A.
Collector, Laxmiposi Zone, Subamarekha Irrigation Project, Baripada, District- Mayurbhanja to disburse the compensation amount in favour of the petitioner as per Section-73 of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act-2013;
And for this act of kindness the Petitioner as in duty bound shall ever pray."

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that though the representation under Annexure-3 Series on this issue is pending with the Zone Officer-cum-L.A. Collector, Laxmiposi Zone,
Subamarekha Irrigation Project, Baripada, Mayurbhanja i.e. Opposite Party No.1 since 07.07.2023,
no communication has been received from the concerned Authority and a direction may be issued to Sarat Mohanty vs Zone Officer-Cum-L.A. .... Opp. ... on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191393808/
1 the Authority for disposal of the same.
5. Learned counsel for the State has no objection to such submission.

6. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, we dispose of the Writ Petition directing the Zone Officer-cum-L.A. Collector, Laxmiposi Zone, Subamarekha Irrigation Project, Baripada,
Mayurbhanja to take a decision on the representation filed by the Petitioner vide Annexure-3 Series and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order.

The order shall be communicated to the Petitioner by the Zone Officer-cum-L.A. Collector, Laxmiposi Zone, Subamarekha Irrigation Project, Baripada,
Mayurbhanja within two weeks of taking the decision.
